Sanne de Vries · PQ-2026-0417 · Evenemen: Sanne de Vries · PQ-2026-0417 · Event permit for the street party in Parkstraat
Beste mevrouw De Vries, Ja, voor een str: Dear Ms De Vries, Yes, a street party with a closed street needs an event permit. You apply for it in Mijn Zuiddrecht under Permits. Include a sketch of where the stalls and the stage will go, and a list of the neighbours who agree. Before we decide, we would like to walk through the street with you. I will send you an appointment for a site visit. Kind regards, Pieter Jansen, Municipality of Zuiddrecht
Komt in Mijn Zuiddrecht en in de mailbox: Goes to Mijn Zuiddrecht and the customer's mailbox
Zet het ticket ook op Wacht op klant: Also set the ticket to Waiting for customer
